MVF3.name: transitivity
MVF3.tactic_planned: Eq.trans  (or  p ▸ q  /  fun p q => p.trans q)
MVF3.feasibility_note: Lean 4 core Eq has .trans; statement = (c1 c2 c3 : Conscious) → c1 = c2 → c2 = c3 → c1 = c3. ~5 LOC. Same day as MVF2.
